incident: The initial S1 inspection printed ancillary genomic/cytogenetic-summary and CINSARC-score columns beyond the intended identity/confounder projection.
scientific_use: Those fields are excluded. No structural/fusion-formation mechanism was investigated, no partner was inferred from cytogenetics and no new panel subgroup expression or statistics were inspected. Earlier R8 panel expression values were already known.
repair: Future extraction uses a strict identity/clinical-specimen whitelist and never prints the full comment or genomic fields. Direct fusion-label reuse requires a separate authoritative specimen crosswalk.
